name: Tableau
description: This Test Connection validates the access against the server and basic metadata extraction of workbooks and views.

steps.name: ServerInfo
steps.description: Validate that the API can properly reach the server
steps.errorMessage: Failed to connect to tableau, please validate the credentials

steps.name: ValidateApiVersion
steps.description: Validate that the entered api version matches with the server api version
steps.errorMessage: Failed to match api versions, please validate the entered version

steps.name: ValidateSiteUrl
steps.description: Validate that the entered site url is in a correct format
steps.errorMessage: Failed to validate site url, please validate the entered value

steps.name: GetWorkbooks
steps.description: List all the workbooks available to the user. We will ingest Workbooks as Dashboards.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch workbooks, please validate if user has access to fetch workbooks

steps.name: GetViews
steps.description: List the Views (charts) from a given Workbook.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch views(charts), please validate if user has access to fetch views

steps.name: GetOwners
steps.description: Validate if the Owner information is retrieved for Workbooks
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch Workbook Owners, please validate if user has access to fetch Owners

steps.name: GetDataModels
steps.description: Validate if the Data Sources(Data Models) information is retrieved for Workbooks
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch Workbook Data Sources, please validate if user has access to fetch Data Sources and Metadata API is enabled for tableau server

steps.name: GetSourceTables
steps.description: Validate if the source tables behind a Data Source are named. Tableau hides table and database names from accounts without Tableau Catalog permissions, which drops the lineage for those tables.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to read the names of one or more source tables, please validate if user has the View capability on those external assets in Tableau Catalog. Data Sources and Dashboards are still ingested, but lineage cannot be built for the tables the account cannot see
